title: Adjunction normal form for the target side of integral exchange
statement: Under exactly the prime, normed coefficient, characteristic, finite-type separated scheme and commutative square hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-exchange-equality], the inverse bounded f′ adjunction hom-equivalence sends the target side of the exchange identity to the explicit composite f′_E(α_g(Rf_I K)) ≫ θ_E(T_Y Rf_I K) ≫ g′_E(α_f(Rf_I K) inverse) ≫ g′_E(T_X ε_f(K)). This is a calculation of only one side; it does not assert equality of the source and target sides.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, compatibility with adjunctions and base change

proof.text: The generic mate/counit identity identifies upper pullback of the scalar push comparison followed by the continuous counit with inverse scalar pull comparison followed by scalar extension of the integral counit. Apply counit naturality and inverse-pull naturality to calculate the adjunct of the target composite.

Use the specified scalar pull comparison composition identity for the two paths of the commutative square. Equality substitution identifies the comparisons of the equal composite scheme maps. Combine these three isomorphism equalities by cancellation to obtain the pull square cube.

The unit-square-counit component formula computes the integral base-change adjunct. Apply pull-comparison naturality to its counit factor, substitute the pull square cube with inverse outer comparisons, and reassociate to obtain the unchanged target normal form.

theorem integralConstructible_exchange_target_adjunct
    (sq : CommSq g' f' f g) (K : integralConstructible ℓ E X) :
    ((boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (f'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((integralScalarConstructible ℓ E Y').map
          ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (sq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app K) ≫
        integralConstructibleTargetHom ℓ E k f' g' K) =
    (boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (f'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).map
        (integralConstructiblePullHom ℓ E k g
          ((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj K)) ≫
      (boundedConstructiblePullbackSquareComparison (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (sq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).hom.app
          ((integralScalarConstructible ℓ E Y).obj
            ((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj K)) ≫
      (boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (g'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).map
        (integralConstructiblePullIso ℓ E k f
          ((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj K)).inv ≫
      (boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (g'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).map
        ((integralScalarConstructible ℓ E X).map
          ((boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).counit.app K))
